subject.title: feat(session): add named new and close chat commands

question: Should OpenClaw core expose `/close` and `/delete` as chat-side session archive commands, and should this PR land on the current `label` contract before the `title` migration settles?
rationale: The remaining parser fix is mechanical, but the destructive command surface and naming-field contract are product/session-state decisions that automation should not settle.

options.title: Repair and accept command surface
options.body: Fix native model-tail compatibility, refresh proof, and land the chat-side archive commands as an intentional core session-management surface.

options.title: Wait for title migration
options.body: Pause this PR until the canonical `title` migration lands or is rejected, then rebase the naming writes onto the chosen contract.

options.title: Drop close/delete from this PR
options.body: Keep only explicit named `/new` work and defer destructive chat-side archive commands to a narrower product decision.

recommendation.title: Repair and accept command surface
recommendation.body: Fix native model-tail compatibility, refresh proof, and land the chat-side archive commands as an intentional core session-management surface.
